title: V1: Coder shows Jev's % done, and Jev works without a key
body:
coder-new (shipped as `coder`) uses Jev only as a `jev` chat tool and as Microcoder's step judge (`done`, `progress`, `repeating`, `complete`). Gaps against INVARIANTS and the owner's rule ("% done" = Jev estimate of completion):

- [ ] **Show the estimate.** `MicrocoderEvents` in `crates/coder-new/src/bundled_runtime.rs` (~1507-1546) drops `Event::Judged` in its catch-all, so coder-new never shows "step N · ≈X% done" (INVARIANTS.md:179). The renderers already exist (`coder-terminal/src/components/run.rs:280`, `openagents-chat/src/coder_events.rs:605`). Forward the judged progress into the run row, and into synced chats so web/mobile show it.
- [ ] **Works without a key.** coder-new never calls `jev_hosted::resolve`, so without a TypeSafe/Vercel key there is no judge and no estimate. Use the keyless relayed path (INVARIANTS.md:38, 202-216) when no key is saved, with the user's own key taking priority.
- [ ] `/plugins` Jev row: show "Built in" when keyless works, instead of "Setup required".
- [ ] Tests: a judged event reaches the run row; no-key path resolves to hosted; own key wins.

No deploys. Terminal 1.0 (#11091) should include this.
